label: Alex O'Connor, Destiny's Ethics Tested by…: Moral statements have no truth value: they are not the…
locator: Alex O'Connor, "Destiny's Ethics Tested by CosmicSkeptic" (Alex O'Connor, 2023-05-22), 17:35–18:25: moral statements don't actually have truth value at all
interpretation: O'Connor's own metaethics, stated as his view ('myself I ... essentially conform to a view called ethical emotivism ... ethical expressions are essentially just emotional expressions ... some form of ethical non-cognitivism'). Read as the plain denial that moral statements have truth value; the expressive ('murder, boo') and prescriptive ('don't murder') positive account is not formalized. This is the answer O'Connor himself gives to the moral-grounding question: moral statements have no objective grounding because they state nothing true or false.
